triggers: audit whether this github release is complete
verify the remote evidence for a published release

rationale: Compared the empty internal catalog plus openai:gh-fix-ci and openai:gh-address-comments. Those external Skills repair failed CI or change code in response to review comments; this capability instead performs a read-only, post-publication audit of repository visibility, merged PR evidence, checks, tag alignment, Release metadata, expected assets, isolated install/call proof, and contributors. Current GitHub CLI and REST documentation is authoritative for the evidence collection commands. Creating one focused Skill is preferable to merging unlike side effects, updating an external capability, or discarding a recurring release gate. The artifact will be checked by the official Skill and Plugin validators, positive and negative trigger cases, an isolated snapshot-script run, and an end-to-end audit of this repository's own release.
